mapper.select: SELECT member_id AS memberId, member_pw AS memberPw, member_name AS memberName, created_at AS createdAt FROM member WHERE member_id = #{memberId}
SELECT member_id AS memberId, mbti, lyrics_preference AS lyricsPreference FROM member_detail WHERE member_id = #{memberId}

SELECT m.member_id AS memberId, m.member_name AS memberName,
md.mbti AS mbti, md.lyrics_preference AS lyricsPreference
FROM member m
LEFT JOIN member_detail md ON m.member_id = md.member_id
WHERE m.member_id = #{memberId}
